_meta.covers: GET /internal/licenses 200 response schema (response_sha256) and every components.schemas entry it transitively $refs (schema_sha256), read from docs/openapi.json
_meta.digest: sha256 of json.dumps(schema, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)
_meta.on_failure: The licences response billing mirrors changed. In billing-service: python3 tests/support/refresh_licences_contract.py (licenses as a sibling, after this change is on origin/main), commit with its .secrets.baseline update; then copy that file's _source.response_sha256 and _source.schema_sha256 here verbatim. Never update this file alone.
